description: Na₂CoAgF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CoF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent AgF₆ octahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.99 Å. Co is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CoF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Co-F bond lengths are 1.94 Å. Ag is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CoF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-F bond lengths are 2.28 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Na, one Co, and one Ag atom.
